modeledSensitivity.scope: Hypothetical unit-rate sensitivity only; rates below are arbitrary analysis inputs, not verified provider quotes, wages, invoices or valuation evidence.
modeledSensitivity.formulaMarginal: hostSeconds / 3600 * hostUsdPerHour + inferenceMillionTokens * inferenceUsdPerMillionTokens + humanMinutes / 60 * humanUsdPerHour + validationMinutes / 60 * validationUsdPerHour + additionalCostUsd
modeledSensitivity.additionalCostDefinition: Tools, infrastructure, acquisition, delivery, support, gas and failure/retry costs only when not already included in time/token totals.
modeledSensitivity.formulaNetIncremental: Documented realization proceeds minus unavoidable realization costs minus matched counterfactual proceeds; never sum estimated capability value and its generated revenues as independent gains.
modeledSensitivity.nullRule: A null required quantity/rate prevents an observed total or target pass. Sensitivity scenarios never fill the actual ledger silently.
modeledSensitivity.sensitivityPurpose: Expose how quickly labor and research allocation can dominate cheap synthetic acquisition.
